review.notes: Full review. Gate at f31d9be fails: tex=1 (README 1983) and sorry-data=4 (Suggested.lean 117, 224, 259, 321), with every other counter 0. The dependency check reports 206 roadmaps, 1897 edges, 0 problems, and no UPWARD or CYCLE line. lake env lean gives only 22 sorry warnings (12 in definitions, 10 in theorems). The one-tactic probe closes none of the 10 theorems. A repaired scratch copy (mutation as a Prop relation, unused definitions removed, FractionRing in place of TotalQuotient) elaborates with only the 10 theorem sorries. Seeded sample: all 15 targets checked; 60 locators in 16 texts (FZ I/II/IV, BZ, BFZ III, FZ98, GHKK, GHK, Chekhov-Shapiro, Nakanishi, Nakanishi-Rupel, BCDX, Rupel, FWZ, Stacks 0E9I, Fock-Goncharov). Every locator present holds; locators are missing in sections 2.2, 3.1 and 4.1. BZ97 was checked only indirectly. Exact Laurent and quantum-torus engines reproduce the README Checks in sections 1.2, 1.5, 2.1 and 2.6. Random rank-3 commutative tests and rank-2/3 quantum tests (u=2, non-reciprocal polynomials, negative weights) found no counterexample to the headline Seed.exists_laurentExpansion, while a control without the dilation law fails 23 of 25. Suppliers resolve on main 7342e8f and at Tau Ceti 2fd255d. No overlap or second owner was found; ownership was checked against main and the open-PR heads through roadmaps grep.
